_source: ASML Annual Report 2023 (5-year financial highlights tables, Total Net Sales table p43-45)

kpis.description_fr: CA total ASML (systèmes lithographie + service). Quasi-monopole EUV, croissance soutenue par AI + nœuds avancés.
kpis.description_en: Total ASML revenue (lithography systems + service). EUV near-monopoly, driven by AI + advanced nodes.

kpis.description_fr: Nombre de systèmes EUV (Extreme Ultraviolet) reconnus en revenu. Tech-clé semi-conducteurs avancés <7nm. Quasi-monopole mondial.
kpis.description_en: EUV (Extreme Ultraviolet) systems recognized in revenue. Key tech for sub-7nm chips. Global near-monopoly.

kpis.description_fr: Marge brute sur ventes. Élevée grâce à pricing power EUV + mix volumes.
kpis.description_en: Gross margin on sales. Elevated thanks to EUV pricing power + volume mix.

kpis.description_fr: R&D ASML. ~14% du CA. Investissement next-gen EUV High NA (0.55) + Hyper NA.
kpis.description_en: ASML R&D. ~14% of revenue. Investment in next-gen EUV High NA (0.55) + Hyper NA.

kpis.description_fr: Nombre total de systèmes lithographie ASML vendus (EUV + DUV + metrology). Inclut DUV immersion populaire en Chine 2023.
kpis.description_en: Total ASML lithography systems sold (EUV + DUV + metrology). Includes DUV immersion popular in China 2023.

kpis.description_fr: Résultat opérationnel ASML. Marge op 32.8% en 2023. Effet levier sur volume EUV.
kpis.description_en: ASML operating income. 32.8% op margin in 2023. Operating leverage on EUV volume.
